user.title: Set up DOEMS
user.description: Create the clean DOEMS configuration. Component-specific input is configured later from Options.

init.title: DOEMS options
init.description: Enable only the components you want to configure now.

energy_forecast.title: Energy Forecast
energy_forecast.description: Choose the Home Power input route and the initial learning profile.

energy_direct.title: Direct Home Power
energy_direct.description: Select one sensor that represents actual current home load.

energy_balance.title: Power Balance
energy_balance.description: Build Home Power from grid, solar and optionally battery power.

data.battery_present: Battery is part of the local power balance

energy_battery.title: Battery power
energy_battery.description: Select positive charge and discharge power magnitudes.

solar_system.title: Solar Foundation
solar_system.description: Configure the generic Solar system contract. Open-Meteo remains the fixed primary provider for the next forecast phase.

data.solar_total_actual_power_entity: Optional total actual solar power sensor

solar_location_override.title: Solar location override
solar_location_override.description: Use an explicit location instead of the Home Assistant location.

solar_inverter_group.title: Inverter group {index} of {count}
solar_inverter_group.description: Configure one stable inverter group. AC limit 0 means unknown/not enforced in P3.0.

solar_array.title: PV array {index} of {count}
solar_array.description: Configure provider-neutral geometry. Azimuth is clockwise from true north: 0=N, 90=E, 180=S, 270=W.

prices.title: Prices Forecast
prices.description: Configure the generic electricity price contract. Stroomvoorspeller supplies the market source; your supplier, tax and import/export components remain local configuration.

data.electricity_fixed_supply_per_day: Fixed electricity supply cost per day

ems.title: EMS battery settings
ems.description: Configure the G6 Step 3A/3B/3C battery, reserve, efficiency, trade-margin and time/mode settings. This screen does not enable planner logic, Away runtime or physical execution.

prices_gas.title: Optional gas prices
prices_gas.description: Choose explicit gas market-price semantics. EnergyZero action mode requests MARKET_WITH_VAT directly; generic sensor mode requires a true EUR/m3 market-price sensor. Only the field for the selected source mode is used.

data.gas_fixed_supply_per_day: Fixed gas supply cost per day

error.doems_source_not_allowed: A DOEMS output entity cannot be used as its own input.
error.source_not_found: The selected entity does not exist.
error.unsupported_unit: The selected sensor must use W or kW.
error.negative_value_not_allowed: This source must be a positive power magnitude.
error.duplicate_actual_source: This actual source is already assigned to another array.
error.total_actual_reused_as_array: For a multi-array system, the total actual source cannot also be assigned to one array.
error.energyzero_config_entry_required: Select a valid EnergyZero config entry for the EnergyZero market action.
error.unsupported_gas_price_unit: The generic gas market sensor must use EUR/m3 (or €/m³).

abort.solar_foundation_invalid: The Solar Foundation topology did not pass structural validation.
